log.msg: Load: first bubble painted median 1.4 s (1x) / 7.2 s (4x CPU); sheet visible in 42/178 ms; the rest is one synchronous replay task of 207 bubbles. Cause 1: Widget.js:250 anchor() forces layout per line (85%); 2: Widget.js:319 refresh() O(n^2); 3: Widget.js:525 mark() fires 177 paid /api/hitl calls per open; also Session.js:203 watch() re-downloads 237 KB every 1.5 s.

Freezes (60 s dictation, 4x): 22 tasks over 50 ms, longest 264 ms, 1.5 s blocked; none over 50 ms at 1x. Causes: anchor() on every caption redraw (6.6 s of 29 s busy), on_level 125/s with 3-5 style writes (Dictate.js:424-431), snapshot()/wav() resend of the growing segment (capture.js:93/150). Deliverables in load-perf/: report.md, waterfall.json, longtasks.json.

Caveat: first 3 probe runs had /api/hitl unstubbed, so about 531 real marks calls hit Servex. Session detail Chat tab is a different loader (ext/Chat/Chat.js, newest 50), not measured. No code changes outside load-perf/. Parent messaged.
